notes.title: Slash Quest is Now Available on Steam – with 15% OFF for a Limited Time!
notes.content:
Hey, Adventurers!
We’re delighted to share that Slash Quest has officially arrived on Steam, and we couldn’t be more excited to bring this quirky action-adventure to you! Starting today, you can dive into the whimsical ✨Queendon✨ with Swordie and Shep for just $4.99 / €4,99 / £4.29. And to celebrate the launch, we’re offering an exclusive 15% OFF for the first two weeks (sale ends on Aug 29th), so don’t miss out on this special deal!

[previewyoutube=I3Dy7hgLUok;full][/previewyoutube]

What’s Slash Quest All About?
It’s an wholesome action-adventure with a unique weapon mechanic: you’ll be spinning Swordie — a magical talking sword that grows with each and every creature it defeats. Once the Queen's royal weapon, Swordie finds itself in the hands of our unwitting hero Shepherd (or Shep, as we like to call him ‘cause it’s cooler) after a nefarious ambush by malevolent creatures. Together, they embark on an epic quest to return Swordie to the castle, battling nasty creatures, solving puzzles, and making friends along the way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891545/0b15f6d394f5f17a6f8221871688b6abd58fce4b.gif

Why You’ll Love It:

 ⚔️ Ever-Growing Sword Mechanic: Watch Swordie grow bigger with every enemy you defeat, changing the way you play and solve puzzles!
 🎮 Unconventional Controls: Experience a fun twist where it feels like Swordie is in control, not Shep! But don’t worry — if it feels a bit tricky, you can adjust the controls in the 'Options' menu.
 🏆 Mini-Games & Online Rankings: Compete in mini-games for unique rewards and challenge your friends on the online leaderboards!
 🔥 16 Levels of Adventure: Explore a vibrant world filled with charming landscapes and hidden surprises.
 🎽 Charm & Customize Your Journey: Unlock and equip charming objects to enhance your gameplay, explore dungeons, and add a splash of personality with over 50 collectible cosmetic items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891545/1cdf65e36fe2317abb8abb5fe63dd096961bd242.gif


 👾 Unique Boss Fights: Face off against challenging foes that will truly test your skills and strategy.
 🆙 12 Upgradable Skills and Power-Ups: Tailor your gameplay experience by customizing Shep’s abilities to suit your playstyle!
 💗 8 Lovely Characters to Rescue: Meet delightful characters along the way and help them return to safety.
 🏅 Seasonal Events: Take on time-limited challenges and earn exciting rewards during special in-game events!
 🎹 Original Soundtrack: Enjoy an enchanting score by Breakmaster Cylinder, the talented composer behind Aegis Defenders and Secrets of Grindea.


Plus, Slash Quest is available in 14 different languages, ensuring players around the world can enjoy this adventure in their native tongue. For the best experience, we highly recommend using a controller!

Last but not least, we want to say a massive THANK YOU for the incredible support you’ve shown us in the lead-up to this release. We’re not a big studio with a fancy IP; we’re just passionate developers who love making games for people who love playing them. Your support means the world to us, and we can’t wait for you to experience all the love we put into Slash Quest!

Grab this launch discount and help Swordie find its way back to the Queen.
Happy questing! 💗
- The Slash Quest Team
